Privacy

Privacy

This website is a set of static pages. It sets no cookies, runs no analytics, loads nothing from third-party servers and has no forms. If you email us, we keep your message to reply to it and do not share it.

Photographs of people on this site were taken at SeaBrick events and are used with the permission of the organiser. If you appear in one and would like it removed, write to us.

SeaBrick Society is a not-for-profit corporation incorporated in Canada in 2022 to promote innovation and standards around environmentally sustainable marine infrastructure building materials.

Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
Corporation number 1378929-2 (Canada Not-for-profit Corporations Act)
